# Relentless Equipment

> Compact equipment, attachment, and trailer rentals on Utah's Wasatch Front —
> skid steers, mini excavators, trenchers, augers, breakers, dump trailers,
> and equipment trailers. Day, week, and month rates.

## About

Relentless Equipment is a rental yard run by a Utah construction family with
two decades of work on the Wasatch Front — a Spravek company, alongside Alpine
Fence & Deck, Harlow Landscapes, and SPX Construction. The fleet works real
jobsites, is serviced on hours, and is inspected between every rental.

- Region: Utah — Wasatch Front (yard in Utah County)
- Cities served: Lehi, Salt Lake City, Sandy, Draper, Alpine, Highland,
  Pleasant Grove, Provo, Saratoga Springs, Eagle Mountain, American Fork,
  Orem, Herriman, Riverton, Bluffdale
- Counties served: Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, Wasatch
- Price tier: contractor / homeowner rental ($$)

## Rentals

- Skid steers & compact track loaders
- Mini excavators
- Trenchers
- Compaction — plate compactors & rollers
- Augers & post drivers

## Attachments

- Buckets — grading, tooth & hi-capacity
- Augers & bits
- Pallet forks & grapples
- Hydraulic breakers
- Brush cutters & mulchers

## Trailers

- Dump trailers
- Equipment / flatbed trailers
- Utility trailers
- Enclosed cargo trailers

## Frequently asked

### How do rentals work?
Reserve by phone, text, or the availability form. Rates are quoted day, week,
or month with deposit, fuel, and damage policies in writing. Pick up at the
yard with a rated tow setup, or ask about jobsite delivery.

### Do you rent attachments without a machine?
Yes. Attachments rent alone or with a machine — tell us the carrier and the
job and we'll match the attachment and hydraulics.

### Are you part of a larger company?
Yes. Relentless Equipment is part of the Alpine Fence & Deck family of
companies — a Spravek company — twenty years of construction craft on the
Wasatch Front, under one accountability line.
